title: Kineto-Cognitive Manifold · Unified Flow

cognitive.notes: High abstract stress; guide deliberate pace + breath.

safety_notes: Not a medical or psychiatric diagnosis system.
User can override pace, haptics, and exit at any time.
No locked rooms, no forced movement, no clinical claims.
Biofeedback sensors (if added later) require consent and wellness-grade labeling.
Do not market as treatment for anxiety, depression, or neurological disease.

unified_flow.principle: Mind and motion are inseparable in real-time feedback; environments amplify both without coercion.

narrative: Across the kineto-cognitive manifold, the user coexists with nested layers: body cues in deliberate mode, room envelope hold at scale ×1.10, AR in stress_soften (complexity 0.25), conceptual BCI intent gain 0.46, and societal frame collab_workspace with openness 0.68.
